# Fallout 76 Patch Notes Hotfix December 11, 2025

![Fallout 76 Patch Notes Hotfix 12/11/2025](/uploads/604_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The patch notes are currently **only in English**, so here is an automatic translation for you. You can find the original text below.

## Update Notes – December 11, 2025

The team released a small update today to address some of the issues discussed since the release of Burning Springs.

- Fixed a bug that could cause some companions to not spawn correctly after building their C.A.M.P. item.
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from placing the “Plastiform Vault Girl” elf decoration in their CAMP.
- The “Cherry Bomb Tinker’s Workbench” workbench has been added back to the C.A.M.P. build options.
- Consoles now correctly play the new main menu music for Burning Springs.
- Ultracite ammo will now correctly unlock when players obtain receiver mods for the Dom Pedro.
- Fixed a bug that caused Pip-Boy navigation to jump to the top of the list when learning new plans.
- Fixed a bug that caused the wrong sleeves to appear when using firearms with the Ulysses outfit.
- Cloak of Fire ability for Cletus Brimstone has been disabled to prevent players from taking unintended additional damage. Unfortunately, although his name was cleared of the player harming allegation, this temporary solution also cleared his name in the game. For now it is referred to as “SEARCH FAILED”.
- An issue with a Bleached Ogua AoE attack that we believe is causing player C.A.M.P.S. corrupted, was fixed by temporarily disabling the ability.
## Known issues

**French voiceover not available**

French voiceover is not available for the Burning Springs update. We know this is disappointing and thank you for your understanding. We are working to bring French voice-over services back as quickly as possible.

**Burning Springs Challenge will not be completed even though all locations have been visited**

The team is aware of the issue and is investigating it. The Burning Springs challenge will not be completed even though all locations have been visited.
